# Qdrant Skills

Skills that teach agents to work with Qdrant Skills. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [qdrant/skills](https://github.com/qdrant/skills), at commit `d2127f6`.

Agent skills for Qdrant vector search: scaling, performance optimization, search quality, monitoring, deployment, edge, model migration, multitenancy, version upgrades, and SDK usage

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Qdrant Skills**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Qdrant Skills**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install qdrant-skills@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

13 skills: `qdrant-clients-sdk`, `qdrant-deployment-options`, `qdrant-edge`, `qdrant-hybrid-cloud-setup`, `qdrant-migration-tool`, `qdrant-model-migration`, `qdrant-monitoring`, `qdrant-multitenancy`, `qdrant-performance-optimization`, `qdrant-scaling`, `qdrant-search-quality`, `qdrant-sizing`, `qdrant-version-upgrade`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
